messages:
maria: Deploybot just kicked off a canary (v2.2.0 -> 5%) in eu-west during the late window. Deploybot telemetry shows a p95 latency bump on the embedding path. @anna @sachin can you eyeball? deploybot id 1749959999

deploybot: Deploy started: v2.2.0 -> 5% (eu-west). Monitoring snapshot: latency_p95 +120ms vs baseline, error_rate 0.3% (baseline 0.1%). To pause: `/deploy pause 1749959999`. To pin/rollback see docs: https://redwood.internal/deploys

sachin: I see the spike — p95 up ~+130ms, tail hitting ~800ms for /v1/embeds. Correlates with KV cache evictions and backend retry bursts. Pulling a quick histogram and pod logs now.

anna: Hold for now. Recommend pin traffic back to v2.1.3 in eu-west and run cache warmup. If p95 doesn't recover in 10m, we roll back. Change window? maria?

maria: Change window open until 23:00 UTC (~40m). I'm +1 to hold and pin. Please avoid broad rollback unless metrics confirm. @support FYI — prep comms if we roll back.

sachin: Running quick log command:```bash
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embed -c model --tail=80 | sed -n '1,40p'
```snippet shows a burst of `evict` at 2026-03-23T21:12:xx and repeated `retry` lines. Example:
```
2026-03-23T21:12:18Z model: kvcache evict key=ctx-abc123
2026-03-23T21:12:19Z model: request retry attempt=1 svc=tokenizer
2026-03-23T21:12:19Z model: request retry attempt=2 svc=tokenizer
```

deploybot: Traffic pinning: eu-west pinned to v2.1.3, canary paused (1749959999). To resume: `/deploy resume 1749959999`. Actioned by anna.

maria: Good. Watch for 5m. If p95 doesn't drop to within +10ms of baseline we roll back globally. Also mark release notes: potential perf regression on v2.2.0 embed path.

sachin: p95 back down to baseline within 3m after pin. Histogram looks clean, errors returned to 0.1%. I'm comfortable with leave-as-is or proceed with a staged reattempt after cache warming.

anna: I still prefer rollback for safety given late window and customer-facing latency. Proposing rollback to v2.1.3 for all regions. Quick vote: +1 rollback, -1 keep and reattempt.

maria: Vote: +1 rollback. Support, please prepare a post-rollback note for release notes and status page. Deploybot, initiate rollback to v2.1.3 for active traffic when ready.

deploybot: Rollback initiated: v2.2.0 -> 0%, v2.1.3 -> 100% across regions. Rolling updates started. Tracking id: rb-1749959999. ETA ~4m.

support: Noted. Drafting status blurb: "We reverted an embed serving change (v2.2.0) after a small latency regression in eu-west. Users may have seen brief increased latency; service restored to v2.1.3." Will post once rollback completes.

maria: Thanks team. Filing a follow-up postmortem/triage ticket and adding the failing prompt sets to Redwood Optimize to catch this for future model/quantization changes.

deploybot: Rollback complete: rb-1749959999. All traffic on v2.1.3. If you need to rehearse a staged warmup, schedule a controlled dry-run in the next change window.
